title: Encounter-Driven City-Scale Human Mobility Generation with Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.17672v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong potential for human mobility generation by modeling individual routines, activities, and mobility preferences. However, existing approaches remain largely resident-centric: generating realistic individual trajectories does not necessarily recover the encounters that emerge when multiple residents co-occur at the same place and time. To this end, we study encounter-aware human mobility generation, which jointly preserves individual mobility and population-level interaction structure. We propose EncounterMob, an encounter-driven LLM framework consisting of a coarse-to-fine Encounter Generator and an Iterative Coupling Framework. The Encounter Generator first captures city-level encounter rhythms and then instantiates participant-time-venue encounters, while the Iterative Coupling Framework coordinates these encounters with personal mobility behavior through successive refinement. translated_title: 基于大语言模型的相遇驱动的城市级人类移动生成
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）通过建模个体日常规律、活动和移动偏好，在人类移动生成方面展现出强大潜力。然而，现有方法在很大程度上仍以居民为中心：生成逼真的个体轨迹并不一定能恢复多个居民在同一时间、同一地点共同出现时所产生的相遇。为此，我们研究相遇感知的人类移动生成，该方法能够同时保留个体移动模式和群体层面的交互结构。我们提出EncounterMob，一个相遇驱动的LLM框架，由从粗到细的相遇生成器（Encounter Generator）和迭代耦合框架（Iterative Coupling Framework）组成。相遇生成器首先捕捉城市级别的相遇节奏，然后实例化参与者-时间-地点维度的相遇，而迭代耦合框架则通过 successive 细化将这些相遇与个人移动行为进行协调。
tldr: 提出EncounterMob框架，通过从粗到细的相遇生成器与迭代耦合机制，首次实现同时保留个体移动模式和群体相遇交互结构的城市级人类移动生成。
en_tdlr: EncounterMob, an encounter-driven LLM framework combining a coarse-to-fine Encounter Generator and an Iterative Coupling Framework, achieves city-scale human mobility generation that jointly preserves individual mobility patterns and population-level encounter structures.
